messages:
ops-bot: Pager: P1 latency + token-cost spike observed in us-west-2. Alerts going to oncall.

tanya_oncall: grabbing. seeing p95 latency from ~180ms -> ~900ms and token billing shows big uptick. No elevated error rate but timeouts creeping. tagging eng-runtime + sre.

leo_runtime: I rolled batch-policy v3.1 at 02:14 (changed auto_batch.window_ms and enabled prefix_coalescing). Rollout targeted to 15% initially.

miguel_sre: can we get kv cache metrics? suspect cache key cardinality explosion.

leo_runtime: quick metrics dump: kv_entries_per_tenant{pool=\"usw2-gpu-1\"} top values: 23000, 19800, 17500. baseline normally <2000. average batch_size ~88 (baseline 20). p95 batch latency 840ms.

tanya_oncall: yep that's a cache blowup causing long GC cycles + longer token times. Which change could allow cross-prefix coalescing?

leo_runtime: prefix_coalescing is the suspect — it merges requests by prefix heuristics. For workloads with many unique prefixes this increases KV churn and keeps entries live.

sam_platform: CS reports two enterprise customers seeing slow experiences: cust-mistral and cust-orion. Both on dedicated pools in the impacted region. Customer ops notified.

jill_cs: cust-mistral is on our escalation list. They're seeing interactive editor lag. They've throttled traffic but want ETA.

miguel_sre: mitigation options: rollback the batch-policy change (fast), set per-tenant overrides to disable prefix_coalescing for affected tenants, or enforce a temporary kv.max_entries_per_tenant cap.

tanya_oncall: do rollback first, then per-tenant overrides for the two customers while we validate. Who can run rollback?

leo_runtime: initiating rollback of batch-policy v3.1 -> v3.0 to the 15% canary hosts now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: batch-policy v3.1 -> v3.0 (canary: 15%).

leo_runtime: also applying per-tenant override for cust-mistral and cust-orion to set auto_batch.max_size=32 and prefix_coalescing=false.

config-bot: Override applied: tenant=cust-mistral keys={auto_batch.max_size:32, prefix_coalescing:false}
config-bot: Override applied: tenant=cust-orion keys={auto_batch.max_size:32, prefix_coalescing:false}

miguel_sre: added temporary limiter on pools: kv.max_entries_per_tenant=6000 to bound memory growth while rollback proceeds.

leo_runtime: canary rollback metrics show batch_size_avg down to ~34 in canary hosts, kv_entries flattening. p95 latency down to 260ms in canary.

sam_platform: notif sent to cust-mistral: "We detected a performance regression and applied a temporary mitigation; our engineers are rolling back a recent batching config change." They asked for a follow-up postmortem.

tanya_oncall: pushing rollback wider: move from 15% -> 50% after validation window (10m).

deploy-bot: Rollback progressed: 15% -> 50%

leo_runtime: after rollout to 50%, region metrics recovered close to baseline. Token cost trend reversing. We should keep per-tenant overrides until hotfix merges.

miguel_sre: agree. Also, we need a granular feature-flagged hotfix that preserves cheap coalescing for low-entropy prefixes but avoids cross-aggregation for high-entropy tenants. Proposed changes: add prefix_entropy check, default auto_batch.max_size reduce to 48, and enforce eviction watermarks per-tenant.

leo_runtime: pulling together PR now (hotfix branch: batch-fix-3.1.1). Will put behind feature flag ff.batch_coalesce_v2 with tenant allowlist.

sam_platform: created FF control. I'll enable for a small test tenant in staging and for a low-traffic production tenant once staging looks good.

tanya_oncall: I'm handing off primary oncall to miguel in 30m. Leave mitigation as-is and keep an eye on rollback status.

miguel_sre: taking over. I'll keep the rollback active and monitor mem/GC, token cost, and p95 latency.

leo_runtime: hotfix deployed to staging; initial perf run shows kv_entries stable and batch_size controlled (~28).

sam_platform: enabling ff.batch_coalesce_v2 for test-tenant-prod (very low traffic) now.

config-bot: Feature flag ff.batch_coalesce_v2 enabled for tenant=test-tenant-prod

leo_runtime: staging -> test-tenant prod telemetry looks good. Plan: phased enablement for additional low-volume customers, then wider rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 20m observation windows.

miguel_sre: keep per-customer overrides for enterprise customers (cust-mistral, cust-orion) until hotfix reaches 100% and we run post-rollout validation for 6 hours.

jill_cs: alerted cust-mistral with mitigation summary and timeline. They requested permanent per-tenant control for the future; logged as customer request.

tanya_oncall: incident summary for handoff:
- 02:14: batch-policy v3.1 partial rollout (15%)
- 02:23: oncall pager triggered for p95 latency + token cost spike
- 02:30: identified KV cache cardinality increase + large batch sizes
- 02:40: rollback started to v3.0 (canary)
- 02:48: per-tenant overrides applied to cust-mistral/cust-orion
- 03:05: kv.limit applied (6000 entries/tenant)
- 03:30: rollback at 50%, metrics improving region-wide
- 04:10: hotfix deployed to staging; FF created and initial canary test tenant enabled

miguel_sre: follow-ups assigned:
- eng-runtime to add prefix-entropy unit/integration tests and hard caps (OWNER: leo_runtime)
- eng-platform to add UI path for rapid per-tenant overrides (OWNER: sam_platform)
- eng-sre to create alert for abnormal kv growth (OWNER: miguel_sre)

leo_runtime: opened PR #4420 batch-fix-3.1.1, request reviews from miguel_sre and tanya_oncall.

config-bot: Incident state: acknowledged -> mitigated. Keep thread updated when resolved.

miguel_sre: marking mitigated. Will schedule a full postmortem draft for tomorrow with timeline, RCA, and customer impact.

jill_cs: customers notified and happy with the quick mitigation. They want confirmation when permanent fix is live.

-- end of thread --
